verdict.rationale: Capacities documents daily notes uniquely linked to each day, an "Open today" command, and a templates feature that prefills object properties and blocks. A community user also praises its daily-notes implementation. However, nothing shows the daily note is created automatically, that a template applies to daily notes specifically, or that it is the default landing view. missing for 10: explicit automatic per-day creation, documented template application to daily notes, evidence that the daily note is the default landing page.

support.subject: As a power-user, I get an automatic daily note for each day, pre-filled from a template, as the default landing place for journaling and capture

citations.quote: A daily note is a note that is uniquely linked to one day. It often serves as a quick and simple way to write down ideas or things to remember as they occur throughout the day.
Execute actions and commands, like “Open today” or “Create new page”, using the search bar.
Templates allow you to prefill the content of an object- you can prefill properties and blocks in your objects.
a very nice implementation of daily notes
